_comment: Sunrise in silhouette. Device: the held horizon and light-first dissolves. Every landscape is cropped so its horizon sits on the same line, 1040 px down, and each change is a luma dissolve: the brightest parts of the next photo burn through first. Two dissolves keep the outgoing photo's subject to the very end, so it is the last thing you see: the lone figure's silhouette is left standing in the amber haze, and the boy's head lingers as the sun breaks through the leaves. The first dissolve does the opposite: the figure's silhouette briefly holds the last of the sunset. The last dissolve is clean light-first into the widest, brightest image, the arena at sunrise, held 4 s.
name: sotr
_tempo_comment: 60 BPM, 4 bars, 16.0 s, 30 frames per beat (120 double time). Post with a slow, swelling sound at 60 or 120; the payoff lands on bar 4 (12.0 s) where the sound should bloom.

shots._note: hook: the sun on the ridge line; horizon at 1040
light-first: for a moment the figure's silhouette is filled with the last of the sunset
the lone figure's silhouette stays standing in the amber haze, then fades last
his head and shoulder linger as the sun through the leaves burns in around them
the payoff: the widest, brightest image, horizon matched to 1040, lands on bar 4 and holds 4 s; loops back to the sun on the ridge
